notes.title: Minor update 0.7.8.1
Science Update 0.7.8
notes.content:
Dear colleagues!

I am pleased to announce that the new research complex "Icarus" officially opens today! This is a milestone event for all of us. Here we will study various anomalous phenomena, with the main focus, of course, on space-time displacement research.

The complex is ready for operation and open to all authorized personnel. However, please note that some areas remain temporarily unavailable as final equipment adjustments are underway. Please exercise caution and follow safety protocols.

Special assignment: Teams "Skald" and "Forward Edge" are tasked with conducting initial stability assessments in the main building.

Wishing everyone productive work! May "Icarus" become our new home for amazing discoveries.

Best regards,
Director of Research

[End of message]

notes.title: Update 0.7.4.0
notes.content:
Friends, we are pleased to present you a new update 0.7.4.0!

In this update we added the mechanics to carry items that players can interact with. Players of both teams can grab items, but only in human form.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/68e635558f13f7edd52fef776308c42afdf2bed7.gif

You can grab items by holding down the "E" key.
Warning! The character will not be able to carry an item that is too large or heavy.


Previously, we added a random forms to items that players can interact with. This mechanics has been added on a several game maps. After extensive testing, we have finalized this mechanics and implemented it on all existing maps in the game!

Now what was a chair in the last match will become a barrel in the next match, and the next one will become as... a cake? A barrel? Or a vase? Now there are more variations items!

In addition, some maps now have more items that you can interact.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/4d9a6318b92bfc34ffadffa8b9ddd9a62393de71.gif

But we will not stop only at random items. We have developments and ideas for improving this system.

Other changes:
- The swampy area on the "Cemetery" map has been fixed, now players will not be able to hide under opaque water;
- Fixed a bug where previously some items had different textures;
- Increased the area in which the mine triggers on the player by 2 times;
- Multiplied some bugs by zero;

We try to make the game a little better and more interesting with each update ❤

notes.title: Fix 0.7.3.5
Small update 0.7.3.4
Update 0.7.3.1
notes.content:
Friends, we have prepared for you a small update that fixes some bugs, as well as adding something new.

Added a new ability for impostors - "Proxy". 
It can only be used in the form of an Prop. When using this ability, the exact same Prop appears at the player's location for a short limited time. Try to confuse the hunters chasing you to win a few seconds to escape!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/f1c25fa0eda281cbb790570c1028b0faa16c5e20.png

Changed the system for receiving damage on prop for inactivity.

Near to the health bar, you can see a new icon that is responsible for visually displaying the level of hunger. The icon only appears when the player transforms into an item.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/87d1e1ca87f800e06273dd55463275cc1ce7f1a8.png

If the player is idle for a while, they will begin to starve, and the bar will gradually begin to dim. During this time, the character will periodically growl in the stomach, which will be heard by players nearby.
As soon as the level of hunger reaches a critical point, the player's health will begin to be taken away, up to 0.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/06050705a3d85e8bdd335be3868e58a7641f4e84.png

With this change, we want to balance the gameplay a bit. Most players try to hide in the farthest corner and not move, occasionally jumping or moving slightly to reset the damage timer (which was before). Now this won't work.

Hunger levels can be replenished with Smoked Meat, which sometimes appears instead of ability cards.
The level of hunger will not decrease if the player in the form of an object moves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/ef81f2a5ada451f55ddba38ed47335f34da68c77.png

When creating a server, you can choose a starvation speed multiplier.

x0.75 - 130 seconds;
x1 - 100 seconds;
x1.25 - 80 seconds;
x1.5 - 65 seconds;
x2 - 50 seconds;
x3 - 35 seconds.

During the specified time, the value of hunger will reach a critical level.

Fixed a performance drop issue on the "Graveyard" map.

Due to a mistake on our part, there was a significant drop in performance on this card. We've fixed that in this update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/2051c0d4a0148b1e7138a0aec055d9a72e34ae01.jpg

Added a small pop-up window informing about the inability to use the ability.
For example, a human impostor cannot become invisible and use the "Proxy" ability, or when there are no items nearby to possess when using the "Possession" ability.

We try to make the game better with each update and always listen to the players! If you have any wishes or suggestions, or maybe you found a bug, please let us know. We will try to fix it as soon as possible!

Thank you ❤

notes.title: Update 0.7.3
notes.content:
Dear players, 
Today we have prepared a new game update for you, and we want to tell you a little about it. 

In this update, we not only added a few new mechanics, but also slightly reworked the existing ones, as well as worked on previously identified bugs.

Game UI.
We have almost completely redesigned the game UI. We were get the task of making it much more convenient and concise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/877528d91b8299f2528cce1eb77289e27ca29917.jpg

We refused inverting the interface when changing the player's team. This confused and disoriented the players. Therefore, we returned to the first UI concept, namely the selection of the player's game UI with a certain color. Props are blue colors, hunters are red colors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/46ba0c06c784db3d96718337b7c7a9d8e4a99390.jpg

Players abilities.
With the UI update, we decided to rework the mechanics of character abilities. Now only 4 ability windows can be seen in the bottom panel. You can still use them by pressing keys 1 to 4 on the keyboard*.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/8ffab4d4c37184a83bc9d464bb38341d1eb78021.png

But do not worry, all the missing abilities remained in place. Now they can be changed. By holding down the key of the corresponding ability, you can call up a drop-down menu. You can select abilities with the mouse wheel, and you can confirm your choice by pressing the left mouse button. The right mouse button can deselect the ability and close the drop-down menu.

*To throw a grenade while playing as a hunter, you need to hold and release the middle mouse button.

Hunter Radar.
This ability has also been changed. The appearance of the radar when used has been completely updated. Now the radar works on 360 degrees. And to prevent further confusion, we've changed the colors of found targets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/77d751571f25644c9c868961f02c3b3d34e3598f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/9b4b7d2f31234e3efa264826cdfc0e7b4677a36f.jpg


 Props are indicated by a blue dot on the radar, and are accompanied by a sound signal. If you hear a signal, know that the opponent is somewhere nearby!
 Hunters are marked with a red dot. No sound when detected.
 Ability cards are indicated by a yellow dot. No sound when detected.


It is important to note that the radar will not show the exact location of the opponent, but will only give a hint and indicate the approximate location. 

Flashbang.
A new ability for hunters has been added to the game - throwing a flashbang. It does not explode immediately, but a few seconds after the initial contact with the surface. If at the time of the explosion the flashbang was in the player's field of view, depending on the distance, the level of stun will depend.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/93ac0bc16929712721c9f77f6c7b6aa9acffbde3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/64ac8dc19141fccdade5b2d86bc10ab67d1f241e.jpg


 If the player is close, they will receive the maximum level of stun, the screen will fill with white light, and there will be ringing in the ears.
 If the player is far away, he will only be slightly blinded.


Previously, we had a flashbang mine and had a bug associated with it. When it exploded, a player behind a wall or other obstacle could be stunned. We have reworked this mechanic, and now the player is only stunned if a grenade or mine explosion occurs in the field of view, there are no overlapping objects.

Visual display of damage on UI.
Previously, it was difficult to keep track of taking damage, only if you did not look at the health bar. The edges of the screen will now dim when taking damage, so players will know for sure that they have taken damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/1e0cc13c6efa01b5600b94c17485d8f082aa3330.jpg

In addition, we have worked on previously identified problems and bugs:

 Fixed the problem with kicking players from the server at the time of connection;
 We solved the problem with kicking players from the server when loading a new map, when the player-server changed the map;
 Fixed a bug where objects sometimes appeared in the center of the map at the start of a new match;
 Fixed a bug with the UI (user interface) when a player had some window open (menu, settings, window of connected players, etc.), and when the match was restarted, it was closed;
 Fixed a bug where the hunter had a black screen at the beginning of the match, but did not always disappear;
 Fixed a bug where a player could "possess" an object that they had previously possessed and which is not on the map;
 Fixed a bug with the ability to fly out of the map "Egypt" playing as an observer (I hope you didn't find anything there);
 Fixed a bug where it was impossible to update the server settings during a running match;
 Fixed a bug where it was impossible to view the entered password when connecting to a private server;
 Fixed a bug when the player's field of view (FOV) was lost when aiming together and changing the camera view from third person to first person, and vice versa;
 Fixed a bug with the animation of reloading a sniper rifle and a shotgun, which previously blocked the camera;
 Fixed lighting on the map "Guild";
 Remapping of the following keys on the keyboard is blocked: 1, 2, 3, 4 (abilities), left mouse button, right mouse button, middle mouse button, mouse wheel up, mouse wheel down, TAB, Enter;
 And some other minor changes mixed with minor bugs.


What would you like to see in future updates? Share your wishes in the comments!

By activating this setting, all the shadows in the game will look as high quality as possible, including the smallest details. Also, shadows will no longer disappear at a great distance.
Below are some screenshots for comparison, with the technology enabled and disabled.

Attention! Activating this item may slightly affect the performance in the game. But when used together with TAAU technology set to "quality", or when used with the TSR anti-aliasing method and reduced image scaling, the performance drop will be minimal.

- Prop movement speed reduced by 25%. Due to the high speed, it was difficult to hit small and fast moving players;
- Sprint only works when moving forward. No more moonwalks;
- Changed the settings menu, soon we will change and adapt the remaining interface (including for controlling with a gamepad and keyboard);
- The minimum mouse sensitivity setting limit has been reduced from 0.5 to 0.2;
- Fixed a bug with stairs on the Japan map;
- Slightly optimized the code;

notes.title: HotFix update 0.7.0.7 is here!
HotFix update 0.7.0.5 is here!
Major update 0.7.0.0 is here!
notes.content:
While everyone was relaxing on the New Year holidays, we continued to work hard to please our audience! Today we are introducing a major update 0.7.0.0 by our standards! This update takes the release of the game one step closer. Early access allows us to fix a lot of bugs and shortcomings, as well as add new content to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/cb3e94df37f73886c375615ed097c2b669e7591b.jpg

This update was developed in parallel with the previous two updates. And we've done a great job!

This is a quick overview of the update in video format, showing key changes.

[previewyoutube=zAodmidbgwU;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Game engine upgrade to Unreal Engine 5

The game engine has been updated to Unreal Engine version 5.1. This opens up a huge scope for the development of the game, including the addition of new modern technologies introduced by Epic in its game engine. This is probably one of the biggest changes in this update. Previously, we used Unreal Engine 4.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/7bd6bb2b99161dd0339d95ab741b6d90282c9e36.jpg

New anti-aliasing method - TSR.

We have added a new image anti-aliasing technology - Temporal Super-Resolution (TSR). With its help, you can natively expand the image with minimal loss of quality.

This technology is an analogue of DLLS and a similar anti-aliasing method Temporal Anti-Aliasing Upsampling (TAAU) built into the engine. This technology is already in use in the game and can provide a performance boost depending on the graphics settings you select. Compared to DLLS and TAAU, TSR has a lightweight algorithm and does not use tensor cores.

Below is a comparison of anti-aliasing methods (TSR, FXAA, MSAA, TAA) and rescaling in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/be32eaf2a1ddcd3d61c53eb2100f4a3179e723a1.jpg

Updated network part.

We were aware of the issue of characters twitching as they moved. This was especially evident if there was a large ping between the players. For a long time we have been working on developing a solution to this problem, and it seems that we have succeeded in doing it! Now the players will not "stutter", they will move smoothly. The only thing is that teleportation of players is still possible (due to desynchronization with the player-server due to high ping) and twitching of objects.

Updated first-person view.

Previously, first person view looked ugly, and most players were swayed by animations in first person view. Now we have completely redesigned the display in the first person. In addition, we have added unique animations for reloading weapons, aiming, and you can also twist it in your hands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/bb54f2468f3b8e7e5b2e34394535197f271fc6c4.jpg

Updated third-person animations.

Also, we have not forgotten about third-person animations, we have updated them too. Sometimes there may be bugs and animations may not be displayed correctly, but we promise to fix them in the next updates.

Added a new weapon for hunters.

I think some players could guess this by the appearance of the pistol icon in the bottom corner 🙂 This innovation is designed to refresh the hunting experience and dilute the gameplay a bit.

In addition to the standard pistol, the following types of weapons are now available to hunters:

- Assault rifle - shoots often, but does little damage per shot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/9a87e598428f0b80d2374071b769843ad84be77d.jpg

-   Shotgun   - shoots rarely, but it hurts. A single pellet does not feel as painful as a full charge;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/a1d454b68e364eba158c0424ea62015856abec3c.jpg

-   Sniper rifle   - shoots far, accurately, and painfully. In terms of rate of fire, it did not go far from the shotgun;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/eefef1cc12c2604239d9f863ee5d32ea97661b58.jpg

Each weapon is individual and has its own strengths and weaknesses. In addition, each weapon has its own spread when fired. Tip - to shoot accurately, you need to aim.

We tried to balance the weapons so that both hunters and props can play comfortably.

Effects from hitting surfaces.

If players shoot at the ground, wood, iron objects, everything will have its own bullet hole, its own effect and sound. Not all surfaces meet the requirements yet, this is still being finalized, we will completely finish it in one of the next updates.

The correct flight path of the thrown object.

We have changed the flight path of thrown objects and added a visual display of the trajectory. Now players will be able to know exactly where the bomb will fly and what will be in its path.

To see the trajectory, you need to hold down the ability key (for a bomb, the default number is 1 or the middle mouse button).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/d41c78a48af72d64affea5b59abcf41866e3155f.jpg

Snowballs are back to props.

We previously cut this mechanic for the reason above (lack of legibility of the flight path). With the introduction of item flight paths, we're bringing snowballs back, and this mechanic is now working the way we originally intended! Now the prop in the form of a man can raise the card, and when the left mouse button is pressed, he will see the flight path. After the player releases the button, the character will throw a snowball.

The animation of throwing bombs and snowballs will be added in the next update, this is currently in the works.

Of the most significant major changes, these are all. Below is a summary of slightly less important changes:

- Objects are highlighted only when aiming at them. Previously, a group of objects within a radius of the player were highlighted. We have changed this mechanic in test mode, if necessary, we will return the previous version.
- Changed the effect of transformation into an object and back into a person;
- Changed the effects of hitting the player;
- Changed the mechanics of the shot;
- Optimization of the game code;

There were no changes to the maps in this update.

We want to warn you that no matter how we test, we might miss some bug or error. We urge all players who encounter bugs to report us via a special thread in the Steam community. We will try our best to resolve the issue as soon as possible.

These are all the changes in this update. But do not rush to get upset, we have a lot of work ahead of us! Of the most important things we can talk about:

- Work on sound accompaniment;
- Work on the user interface (UI);
- Work on maps and lighting;
- Continued work on optimization and bug fixes;
- Finish what you started in this update;

Thank you for your attention, eat apples!

notes.title: Christmas update 0.6.16.0!
Hotfix 0.6.15.1 is here!
notes.content:
We continue to work on fixing bugs!
For a long time, we have been receiving complaints from players about twitches and jerks in the movement of characters. In this small fix, we tried to get rid of this problem. We consider this update important, so without waiting for the next update, we make it available now!

Fixed a pistol hanging in the air when a hunter spawns.
And fixed the highlighting of the impostor player (in the form of an item) together with the item from which he took the form, when a hunter shoots at this object.

Feel free to tell us about bugs in the game, we study them all and send them for revision.

A few of the issues we know of that are in the pipeline for fixing are incorrect display of bonus cards (For example, a player picking up a "bomb" card can get a "first aid kit"), there are problems with the game user interface. Sometimes elements and inscriptions do not appear or disappear. We are aware of these bugs and are working on fixing them! But we want to note that we give priority in solving problems to more significant bugs, which directly affect the perception of the gameplay.

notes.title: Fix 0.6.11.1
🛠 Update 0.6.11.0 is now available!
notes.content:
We present to your attention update 0.6.11.0! 

This update is a small step towards extending PropHunter and making it even more interesting!

New game mode!

The main highlight of this update was the release of the Obstacle Course game mode into the beta test. In this mode, players are divided into two teams: hunters and props.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/ebfe29991fe0d497daa367c9538f4e58cde41718.png

The task of hunters is to prevent props from reaching the end of the route using traps prepared in advance on the maps!

The task of the props is to deftly dodge all the prepared traps and reach the finish line. To win, you need to pick up an ability card with snowballs and punish the offender!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/8505ba7bdbfa0ab89341ff70d393c19233e33282.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/f64da98dac3d09dbe85d42b69d98c215c1f2a983.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/acc7590bed624f81f4481510bd6ff661af82ac3d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/c56f29c98165fa08c5d1b1170916f5a14b7436e1.png

At this stage, one map is available in the mode. Before we go any further, we want to rid the mode of possible flaws and bugs. We also want to get feedback on this mode from the players. If you have already played, give feedback in the community center, this is important for us! Also, if you encounter a bug (not necessarily in this mode, anywhere), write about it in as much detail as possible in the appropriate topic in the community center!

It is highly recommended to test the new mode with your friends and by communication to get the best gaming experience.

At the final stage, this mode and maps may differ from the beta mode.

This is not the only new mode that is coming to PropHunter, we want to do everything gradually and smoothly. We will not make road maps, promises and loud statements, because this has nothing to do with reality. Updates will be released as soon as they are ready.

New game map!

The second main innovation of this update was a new map. Yes, recently we have already released a new card, but what prevents you from releasing another one?

“Viking Fort”.

The map turned out to be spacious, and some buildings can be entered.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/967cdb318a28517ef7f6219bce06e7309a41e249.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/cd5c702f2ac9f8123dede0b27a5ade2f484c0b32.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/67d41f922bfeb98953f05aded608f025614f3fe6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/47c0e0abe40d457f73749316f94d16780f84a7a8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/bae29a8e53f72addcceea0fb6f7b06a46a142b79.png

Of the less significant changes (but which need to be mentioned):

- Added tips for players at the map loading stage. Tips of a general nature and specific modes (control, game features, etc.);
- Added a tooltip when aiming at an object with which you can interact;
- In the control settings, the ability to change the assignment of keys for turning while playing as a prop has been added;
- Fixed the highlighting of objects (sometimes the highlight disappeared);
- Fixed the display of skins for hunters (yes, again, 4th update with this bug);
- Fixed the performance of achievements and added a couple of new ones;
- Added a few more bugs.

Why is feedback important to us? Not all errors can be found by us. Our view of some things may be “blurred”, so sometimes we need feedback from the outside. We want to develop PropHunter together with the players!

On this we do not say goodbye, but only leave to work on the game further in order to continue to please you!

notes.title: Fix 0.6.10.3
Fix 0.6.10.2
🛠 Update 0.6.10 is now available!
notes.content:
Introducing update 0.6.10! 

This is a fairly large update in that a new game map, character customization, server settings, and many other changes into the game.

New map
A new game map has been added to the game - "Industrial Area". This is a medium sized map but has a lot of places to hide!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/fd7cc8be234bf6cce1114b4087a42e0c4078321d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/d27c0037bff9deafd1c26eb8fbcae388ce6c1f34.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/b8f900e00d22707b93b3c1d0ce86709614de6070.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/eb28f3c96d9fd4143099c4c85e7f9ffe5918cc9b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/16ce7631ec0db85b58922946b3e4564535909478.png

Character customization

Character customization has been added before, but it's finally fixed in this update! Now you can choose how your character will look like, choose one of the presented colors for him. In this way, you can personalize not only the props, but also the hunter!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/1bc863a0944049cd9eb05f84a7ce5ee435d997e8.png

Server settings

Now if the players want to change the map, or change the settings of the match, it is not necessary to dissolve the session. The player who created the server can independently apply all the necessary changes (change the name of the server, set or remove the password, change the map or change other settings). All changes will be applied immediately or at the end of the match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/f0d26656c2acf0c0782cfdda943f4d551127f965.png

You can invite friends directly from the server
Now players can invite their friends who have a copy of the game to the server! After sending the invitation, the second player will receive notifications from Steam that you are inviting the player to your session.

Props
Now the maps will have not only static items, but also random ones! This means that anything can appear in one place! This can increase the level of replay value by making it harder to remember the location of each item! This means that props can hide more effectively!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/d35a9ade9505fdbb3ee680b4b17e73e133bf96b6.gif

Abilities
The changes also affected ability cards. Now when you pick up several cards of the same bonus - they accumulate! But you can also use them after a certain time.
Medkits can now also be stockpiled and used on a timer. By default, the button for using the first-aid kit is assigned to "H", you can change it in the control settings.

Miscellaneous changes
* After the start of the match, the new joined player will be an spectator, but at the same time he has the opportunity to join the match for the hunter team;
* The player-server can now kick other players, ban on his server and turn off chat to other players. This feature is experimental and if it is noticed that players are abusing it, the functionality will be disabled;
* As an additional weapon, snowballs were added (functionality being finalized);
* Added damage during the downtime of the prop player. This is a configurable parameter and is set when the server is created, or changed during the game;
* Human props can pick up snowball cards and use them against hunters;
* Fixed some bugs;
* Added new bugs;

If you encounter a bug, write about it in the Steam community. The more detailed you describe the problem, the more likely it is to be successfully solved!

On this we do not say goodbye, another update is in the works now!

notes.title: 🛠 Update 0.5.2.0 is available!
notes.content:
Hello friends! Today we present you with a new update 0.5.2.0

Summer is drawing to a close. You with friends are returning home from vacation. To back home faster, you've decided to hijack a ship! But the main question appears. You cannot decide in any way who will be the captain of the ship, props or hunters! Let's find it out on a new map "Old Warship" on the high seas! And don't worry if you fall into the water, you will still end up on the ship. You won't be able to escape 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/b927623bc13ec5c7c0c24e2c9391c1f3b08b6e7f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/7c1a6a94b15953518a3ac7b12f9cbd81a2fe3129.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/25f41ce61f225ec6b19fc32922710b0af1b26b4a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/c580f49bdb1846c18ad8180bf64aba07590c1c0b.png

In this update changes have been made to hunters. Now, when a player becomes a hunter, a black screen appears for 10 seconds, so that the props have time to hide properly and the hunters do not spy on them! And so that cunning props do not eliminate hunters while they do not see anything, hunters have invulnerability for the duration of the black screen!

Another change has been made to the in-game chat. Now you can see the history of the last messages sent.

We also fixed a bug due to which sometimes characters were in T-pose (no animations).

Now, after spawning, the characters will not fly in all directions (this was due to the fact that two or more players appeared at one spawn-point and they pushed each other with such force that everyone flew to the sides).

Fixed bugs with collisions, sounds and UI.

And of course, one of the main events of this update - Trading Cards, Badges, unique emoticons and profile backgrounds are now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888789/037ac98a34ec30499bac669b12c92eb5da1049c7.png

If you find a bug, you have a wish or suggestion for developers - you can write about it in the appropriate topic in the Steam community center.

And to learn about updates in advance, visit our Discord server - https://discord.gg/ekYBAmsJzc
There we also receive information on bugs, suggestions and communicate with players. And also players can communicate with each other!

On this we do not say goodbye, but just leave to continue our working days to please you with new updates!

notes.title: Update 0.5.1.6 coming out!
notes.content:
We have released a new update!
We fixed several bugs, but the main change in this update is that we disabled physical properties for objects that are not props. This decision was made after we saw players getting stuck in the "air" due to overturned sofas, tables and chairs.
We also rebalanced the number of ability-cards at levels. We've added more cards for hunter.

We would like to express our special gratitude to all streamers who played our game! With their help, we could observe the gameplay in real time and find errors and bugs that escaped our attention. And also thanks to those players who write to us about problems and bugs in the game in the community center. With your help, we are trying to make the game better and better! 

We are already working on a new update, stay tuned!

notes.content:
We have prepared and released a small update!
In the first days, several minor bugs were discovered. The main problem was the sound of the shot and reloading, it was not localized by mistake. But we fixed it, now your ears will not hurt from several dozen shots at the same time 😅

We also made many other small fixes in the game.

In order for you to play with the players, you must update to the latest current version in Steam, otherwise there will be an error about the incompatibility of updates when you try to connect to other players.
